name: OpenGL Mesh Setup (VAO/VBO/EBO)
definition: Initializes OpenGL vertex arrays and buffers for a static mesh, uploading vertex positions, normals, and texture coordinates, then clearing host memory.
summary: OpenGL Mesh Setup initializes static meshes by uploading vertex data to GPU buffers, distinguished by explicitly managing VAO, VBO, and EBO lifecycles to decouple host and GPU storage.
